title: Surgical Evolution Over Blunt Overwrite
description: Evaluate current state first. If an existing card, config, or module is already high quality, keep it untouched. Only update what requires updating (KEEP_EXISTING vs UPDATE_REQUIRED vs ADD_NEW).
ai_training_notes: Never perform mass overwrites or replace working code with blunt templates. Diff existing state against desired state and apply surgical modifications.
satisfaction_driver: User values preserving previous working state and hates indiscriminate rewrites that lose context.
